newsitem.title: FINLAND: AAMULEHTI SELLS REAL ESTATE TO OPR.
newsitem.headline: AAMULEHTI SELLS REAL ESTATE TO OPR.

text.p: Finnish media group Aamulehti-yhtyma Oy said on Thursday it had sold real estate in Tampere to OP-Rahoitus Oy (OPR) for 50 million markka and that the deal would have a positive impact on group 1996 earnings.
"Through the deal, Aamulehti-yhtyma released funds from real estates to its core business," Aamulehti said in a statement.
"The deal will also have a positive impact on Aamulehti-yhtyma's 1996 earnings," it added.
The real estate sales profit would boost the parent company's 1996 earnings by 45 million markka, Aamulehti said.

Aamulehti said it had made a five-year leasing agreement on the 13,000 square metres real estate with OPR, part of OKOBANK. The deal, which was completed at the end of 1996, will not affect Aamulehti's equity to assets ratio, it said.

Aamulehti's January-August 1996 profit before extraordinary items and taxes was 63 million markka, up from 57 million markka in the first eight months of 1995, and its equity to assets ratio rose to 42 percent from 41 percent at the end of 1995.
Group full-year 1995 profit before extraordinaries and taxes was 87 million markka, up from 62 million in 1994.
